title: Egyptian Pork Kebabs
description: Tender pork kebabs marinated in a blend of Middle Eastern spices, then roasted to perfection. Serve with a side of couscous or pita bread for a delicious and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cut the meat into uniform pieces for even cooking.

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the kebabs in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
Remove the kebabs from the oven and brush with lemon juice.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
